attackers_goals: An adversary may use different protocols to enumerate and plan its lateral movement over the network.
description: An endpoint performed a new, unfamiliar SMB activity to multiple hosts on the network.
investigative_actions: Verify if the host is a newly deployed server that consists of SMB services to multiple hosts. Verify the legitimacy of the actor process (and its causality) that initiated this SMB traffic.
